critical_saturation_finding.interpretation: ANY-divergence is saturated when M1/M5/M15/H1/H4 x five oscillators x two pivot scales are pooled. It is not a usable gate as currently aggregated.
critical_saturation_finding.root_cause: The latest two causal confirmed pivots are used without a recency/locality restriction, so older divergence context can persist until a newer same-side pivot pair replaces it.

divergence_age_observation.note: Age is normalized by the event timeframe. This confirms that many recorded divergences are ambient/older context rather than fresh reversal evidence.

exploratory_individual_context_examples.warning: Not validated and may be inflated by divergence persistence/recency confounding.

interpretation: Regular and hidden divergence remain promising structural features, but the pooled ANY flags are unusable because they are saturated.
Regular divergence should be tested as potential reversal evidence and hidden divergence as potential trend-continuation/pullback evidence, without assuming either is beneficial.
The next audit must distinguish fresh divergence from stale ambient context and distinguish pivots formed during the current adverse episode from pivots that pre-date the signal.
Effects must remain separated by ticker, direction, timeframe, oscillator, pivot scale and month.
